sentences: Kim Jeong-hui painted this in exile on Jeju Island as a gift for his student Yi Sang-jeok.
When everyone else abandoned the disgraced scholar, Yi kept sending him rare books obtained in China, carried across the sea.
Kim answered that loyalty with a line from Confucius: only when the year turns cold do we see that the pine and the cypress are the last to fade.
The picture holds just a humble house and four trees; everything else is empty winter air.
The lines, drawn with a dry brush, are plain and therefore strong.
Later, Chinese scholars and Korean collectors added their own colophons, and today the scroll stretches more than ten meters.
